_Requested by **Lucas** · [project
thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01SU1kLYmWeT4ejAYnBNpQjs?thread=cmsg_01SU1kLYmWeT4ejAYnBNpQjs9tHa7woX9xn9uXyAo2CtXi)_

## Scope

Follow-up to #1129, workflow only. Actions cache keys can't be
overwritten, so with a sha-only key (`build-cache-v1-OS-ENV-sha`), a
second `audit_build_cache` run on a main revision that already has a
saved cache could not save its refreshed cache; `actions/cache/save`
only warns. The save key (and the restore step's primary key) now ends
in `-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}`, matching the
shared handbook's starter template. Restores still use the
`build-cache-v1-OS-ENV-` prefix, which picks the newest entry. Guards,
cache modes and the audit are unchanged.

`tests/test_ci_policy.py` gains a check that the save key includes the
sha, run id and attempt.

**Site impact:** this changes the `baseline.yml` blob to
`445ddeac5b1172284e8142e5a80b6c55949261ea`. The site's
`config/nflstreet2-producer.json` `workflowBlobs` must approve it before
main runs from this workflow can be imported (mitsevox.github.io PR #5
currently adds `e6ae8f63…`).

## Validation

- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_policy`: 8 tests OK.
- CI on this PR (pending).
